subject: crossks: fix 'GC life time is shorter than' error when accessing infoschema (#62378)
summary: Reviewed the infoschema loader/builder changes only (diff vs first parent). The commit introduces `LoadMode` to force cross-keyspace loading to always use infoschema v1 (avoids long-lived InfoSchemaV2 holding an old snapshot TS and later hitting the GC-safepoint error), and threads a single captured `schemaCacheSize` through loader/builder paths to keep v1/v2 decisions consistent within a reload. No Blocker/High issues found in correctness, metadata consistency, concurrency, or v1/v2 switching logic for the touched infoschema paths.
